command: set -o pipefail; echo '=== UNIT ==='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p DropInPaths -p ExecCondition -p ExecStopPost --no-pager 2>&1 || true; echo '=== GUARD TARGETS ==='; for p in /usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/20-semantic-state-cutover.conf; do if sudo -n test -e "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo PRESENT:$p; sudo -n sha256sum "$p"; else echo ABSENT:$p; fi; done; echo '=== CONFIG BINDS ==='; sudo -n grep '^ENTITYOS_IDENTITY_BINDS=' /etc/entityos/entityos.conf 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== RESCUE ==='; if sudo -n test -d /var/lib/entityos/data/volatile-state-rescue; then sudo -n find /var/lib/entityos/data/volatile-state-rescue -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p|%s|%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -80; else echo NO_RESCUE_DIR; fi; echo '=== CUTOVER ==='; if sudo -n test -d /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state; then sudo -n find /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state -maxdepth 4 -type f -printf '%p|%s|%TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -80; else echo NO_SEMANTIC_STATE_DIR; fi; echo '=== VOLATILE MTIMES ==='; for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db; do sudo -n stat -c '%n|%s|%y' "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING:$p; done; echo '=== LIVE SELF-INTEGRATION ==='; git -C /home/andreas/self-integration rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; git -C /home/andreas/self-integration status --short 2>/dev/null || true
